name: generic_dataset_eval
description: Dataset-agnostic general, schema, quality, analysis-readiness, and cleaning-boundary evaluation pack.
scoring_notes: This pack is dataset-agnostic and should run before any domain-specific benchmark.
Standard answers are generated from uploaded files after the case manifest is defined.
Domain-specific questions such as YoY, airport share, CBD fee, inventory turnover, ARR, or cohort retention should be added as separate extension packs.
Cleaning cases are simulations only; the runner never mutates source files.
